text:
Maya Chen: Quick pulse — telemetry hooks for the new GPU slate (rack-5b) need verification. Are owners wired into alerts/ops playbooks? Need sign-off by EOD tomorrow so we can start reservation handoff Monday.

Jon Patel: We're missing node-exporter labels on the new nodes, so Prom scraping drops some metrics. I've opened infra#4571 — will link logs in a sec.

Sophie Laurent: I pushed a tag patch to the provisioning script, PR #4574 merged. Rolling to staging tonight at 23:00 PT. Will follow up here when staging scrape looks good.

Ricardo Gomez: Runtime note: KV cache warmup doesn't expose hit_rate by default. Can we add a metric "redwood_runtime_kv_cache_hit_rate"? I can spike a branch and share.

Luke Morgan: I'll draft alerts for SRE once the metric exists. Primary alerts: kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.7 for 5m, nvml_gpu_temp_celsius > 85 for 2m, node_unavailable for 1m.

Maya Chen: @Jon remind infra to add owner tag field "capacity_owner" to node metadata so handoff automation can pick it up.

Jon Patel: Yep, will add "capacity_owner" to the provisioner template. Also filing infra#4575 to backfill existing nodes.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: rack-5b node-exporter tagging rollout started (job 8843). No failures so far.

Sophie Laurent: staging scrape shows node_exporter labels present on 9/10 nodes. One node still missing "rack" tag, investigating.

Ricardo Gomez: Branch with metric added: github.com/redwood/runtime/compare/feature/kv-metrics — exposes prometheus metric, demo histogram + gauge. Will post a short README.

Maya Chen: OK let's also add a short playbook snippet for oncall. @Luke can you drop a minimal alert runbook?

Luke Morgan: Sure, dropping minimal runbook below:
```
Runbook: KV cache alert
- Check runtime pods on rack-5b: kubectl -n runtime get pods -o wide
- Check metric: sum(rate(redwood_runtime_kv_cache_hit_rate[5m]))
- If below 0.7 and rolling, escalate to runtime oncall @ricardo
- If metric missing, check node-exporter scrape targets and prometheus relabel configs.
```

Jon Patel: Backfill ticket created. ETA for backfill: Weds 05:00 PT.

Maya Chen: EOD sign-off checklist: telemetry present, alert rules in sandbox, owner tags set, reservation script points to owner metadata. Can everyone confirm status? :eyes:

Sophie Laurent: Telemetry + tags — staging good. Will confirm post-prod roll at 23:00.

Ricardo Gomez: Metric PR posted, awaiting review. Can do hotfix if needed during canary.

Luke Morgan: Alert rules drafted in sandbox, will promote after PR merged. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Great — if no blockers I'll mark handoff ready Monday AM and open reservation windows. Thanks all.
